# SynPlanner

> A toolbox for chemical synthesis planning: retrosynthetic route search, reaction
> data curation, reaction rule extraction, and analysis of synthetic routes.

SynPlanner is built on **chython** (chython-synplan, formerly CGRtools), a
pure-Python chemoinformatics engine — not RDKit. Canonical SMILES from chython do
not match canonical SMILES from RDKit for the same molecule, so never compare
SMILES strings across the two engines; parse through one engine and compare the
objects, or compare InChI. 

## For AI agents

- [Agent skill](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent_skill.html): how to use SynPlanner correctly — read before writing any code
- [Agent skill, raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Laboratoire-de-Chemoinformatique/SynPlanner/main/skills/synplanner-usage/SKILL.md): the same file, plain Markdown, one fetch
- [Task index](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tasks.html): every task mapped to the API pieces it needs, in order
- [Task index, raw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Laboratoire-de-Chemoinformatique/SynPlanner/main/skills/synplanner-usage/references/tasks.md): the same file, plain Markdown

## Start here

- [10 minutes to SynPlanner](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/ten_minutes.html): install, download data, plan a first route
- [Installation](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/get_started/installation.html): pip, Docker, uv from source; choosing a PyTorch build
- [Data download](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/get_started/data_download.html): models and building blocks are not bundled and must be fetched

## Using SynPlanner

- [Command-line interface](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/cli_interface.html): every command; prefer the CLI for long runs
- [Configuration](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration/configuration.html): the YAML knobs for each pipeline stage
- [Synthons](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration/synthonisation.html): cutting molecules into synthons against a building-block catalogue, and enumerating libraries from them — a different question from planning a route
- [Retrosynthetic planning](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/planning.html): what the planner does
- [Priority rules](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/priority_rules.html): custom retrosynthetic SMARTS
- [Monte-Carlo tree search](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/mcts.html): search algorithms, alternatives, tree analytics
- [Routes](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/routes.html): RouteCGR deconvolution and the typed route APIs
- [Migration guide](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/migration.html): read this if code or SMARTS from an older version behaves differently

## Building your own planner

- [Reaction standardization](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/standardization.html): mapping, enforcement, and the required order
- [Reaction filtration](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/filtration.html)
- [Reaction rules](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/extraction.html): extraction protocol and functional groups
- [Policy network](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/policy.html): ranking and filtering policies
- [Value network](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/methods/value.html)
- [Tutorials](https://synplanner.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/index.html): seventeen worked notebooks
